Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used immunoprecipitation (AP-MS) to isolate FAM134B-FLAG and analyze PTMs (phosphorylation and acetylation). Acquisition is DDA based on the 'most abundant multiply charged precursor ions' selection logic. Quantification is listed as peptide counting in PRIDE metadata.

scope: Two 15 cm plates expressing FAM134B-FLAG and either HA-SOPF or mock plasmid cultured to 90–100% confluency were starved for amino acids for 1 h and subjected to immunoprecipitation.

Beads were eluted with 100 μL Glycine 0.1 M pH3 for 10 min with constant rocking and immediately neutralized with 10 μL 0.5 M Tris-HCl pH 7.4 1.5 M NaCl. Elutes were subjected to mass spectrometry analysis to identify post‐translational modifications.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material obtained via immunoprecipitation of FAM134B-FLAG, which constitutes an affinity-purified complex scope.
